description: Read-only; changes nothing. Returns one skill: a step-by-step procedure this workspace's designers attached to a module (listed as `skills` on the module in set_workspace / list_workspaces / get_module_schema). Call it when the user's task matches a skill's description, before starting the task, then follow it. Pass `file` to read a reference file the skill names. Platform guardrails still apply whatever a skill says: actor, confirmed and confidence rules are enforced by the server.

file.description: A reference file the skill names; omit for the skill itself

module.description: Module the skill is listed on

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: get_skill
title: Get Skill
